references.phrase: unique output y for each x
references.context: For every x∈X exists exactly one y∈Y such that ordered pair (x,y)∈G.

references.phrase: bare graph does not determine codomain Y
references.disposition: Same graph may be embedded in multiple ambient codomains, even with fixed domain.

review_rationale: Read bare graph of a mapping as subset of X×Y with exactly one output per input, stressing graph-only data do not intrinsically retain codomain type.
